whatIsNLB.question: What is Next Level Builders?
whatIsNLB.answer: Next Level Builders is an educational platform and builder resource hub for solopreneurs and micro-SaaS founders. We provide expert-curated playbooks, recorded sessions, proven templates, and launch tooling to help you build and scale profitable products faster, with an included community collaboration channel. Our founders have built 14+ products generating $100K+ ARR.

refundPolicy.question: What's the refund policy?
refundPolicy.answer: 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked. If the community and library aren't a fit within your first 30 days, request a 100% refund and we'll process it. We stand behind the value we ship.

timeCommitment.question: How much time do I need to commit?
timeCommitment.answer: You only need 3-6 hours per week (Discord + self-practice). This is completely manageable even if you work full-time. You don't need to quit your job, have a team, or a large budget. All you need is your current skills (being able to build a product is OK) and commitment to ship, not perfection.

isItACourse.question: Is this an online course?
isItACourse.answer: No! This is not a traditional theoretical course for getting a certificate. This is a practical educational and builder resource platform helping Builders achieve: Product launch (live, public), Users & customers willing to pay (real validation), Pre-order revenue (early proof of market fit), and actionable lessons to ship products effectively.

whatWillILearn.question: What will I learn in this program?
whatWillILearn.answer: You'll understand how to build a personal brand that converts, build an automated sales system 24/7, launch products in reality with real customers, and gain skills to ship fast & scalable like battle-tested founders. This is hands-on, practical knowledge from founders who have built 14+ profitable products generating $100K+ ARR.

needTechnical.question: Do I need to be technical?
needTechnical.answer: You need current skills to build a product (code, no-code, AI tools - whatever works). You DON'T need to quit your job, have a team, or a large budget. Solo founders working full-time are welcome. Cheap tools are enough to get started.

technicalLevel.question: What technical level is required?
technicalLevel.answer: All levels welcome! We have complete beginners learning to code, experienced developers, and non-technical founders using no-code tools. Our content caters to different skill levels, and the community is very supportive of newcomers.

tierIncludes.question: What's included in each tier?
tierIncludes.answer: Premium tier includes the full 52-week recorded session library, eLearning video treasury, template vault, and community collaboration channels. VIP adds priority Q&A channels, early access to new tools and content, 1:1 private launch teardowns and structured positioning reviews delivered privately to you, and the VIP template + AI prompt vault.

howDiscordWorks.question: How does Discord work?
howDiscordWorks.answer: Discord is a free chat platform (like Slack). Once you join NLB, you'll get an invite link to our private server. We have channels for different topics, weekly content drops, and a supportive community. It's mobile-friendly and very easy to use.

whatMakesDifferent.question: What makes NLB different from other communities?
whatMakesDifferent.answer: Most communities are run by people who haven't built successful products. Our founders have 14+ profitable products and $100K+ ARR. We share real strategies that work, not theory. Plus our community is highly engaged with 500+ active members actually building and launching products.

upgradePlan.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
upgradePlan.answer: Yes! You can upgrade anytime and immediately get access to higher tier benefits. Downgrading is also easy - just let us know before your next billing cycle. Pro-rated refunds available when upgrading.

freeTrial.question: Is there a free trial?
freeTrial.answer: We don't offer free trials, but we have a 30-day money-back guarantee which is even better. This gives you a full month to experience the community, browse the library, and see if it's right for you - completely risk-free.

policies.title: Policies & Guidelines
policies.subtitle: All policies and guidelines of the Next Level Builders community

sections.heading: Vision & Mission
sections.content:
NextLevelBuilder (NLB) is a community of hands-on Builders — where every member actively SHIPs (publishes products, content, and value to the world) or CONTRIBUTEs (builds the community).

"No Ship, No Seat" — If you don't ship, you don't have a seat in the community.

sections.heading: Two Paths to Join
sections.content:
• SHIP: Commit to 4 public posts/month, share in Discord #ship — for those who want to Build in Public
• CONTRIBUTE: 45-day trial period, weekly reports — for those who want to contribute technically or to the community

sections.heading: Two Membership Types
sections.content:
• Premium: Full standard benefits — Discord, content drops, resources, community support
• VIP: Premium + priority slots, early access, priority Discord DM with Mentor, direct Mentor access

sections.heading: Ranking System
sections.content:
Rank is based on contributions, independent from membership type:
• Apprentice: New members (0–45 days)
• Builder: ≥8 SHIPs + 80% feedback
• Architect: ≥20 SHIPs + 90% feedback + highlighted post
• Master: ≥50 SHIPs + Featured/Contributor
• Legend: ≥100 SHIPs + Mentor nomination

sections.heading: Required Commitments
sections.content:
• Complete personal information (verified by admin)
• Submit Feedback Weekly every week
• Read and agree to all community guidelines
• SHIP 4 posts/month OR be approved as a Contributor

sections.heading: Ranking Points (RP)
sections.content:
• SHIP a post: +10 RP
• SHIP gets highlighted: +25 RP
• Feedback weekly: +5 RP
• Active in Discord (week): +3 RP
• Help a member: +8 RP
• Featured contributor: +50 RP
• Contributor work/week: +15 RP

sections.heading: What is SHIP?
sections.content:
SHIP means publishing anything you're building, learning, or sharing to the public — articles, products, ideas, experiences...

"Ship early, ship often, ship with intention."

sections.heading: Minimum SHIP Commitment
sections.content:
• Quantity: At least 4 times/month (avg. once/week), not all at the end of the month
• Format: Public posts with links (blog, social media, website...)
• Report: Share the link in the #ship Discord channel
• Purpose: So the community can support, engage, and give feedback

sections.heading: What Counts as a SHIP
sections.content:
Accepted:
• Personal profile: Introducing yourself, LinkedIn updates, portfolio
• Product: MVP, beta, new feature, demo
• Expert knowledge: Tutorial, guides, tips & tricks
• Work experience: Lessons learned, behind the scenes
• Ideas: Concept, wireframe, validation

Not accepted:
• Simple reposts/shares without original content
• Private posts without a public link
• Comments on others' posts

sections.heading: Weekly SHIP Process
sections.content:
1. Create content (article, video, product...)
2. Post it PUBLIC (blog, social, website...)
3. Copy the post link
4. Share it in the #ship Discord channel
5. Community comes in to support and engage

sections.heading: Monthly Evaluation
sections.content:
• 0–1 posts: Not met — Warning
• 2–3 posts: Below expectation — Reminder
• 4+ posts: Meets requirement
• 8+ posts: Outstanding
• 12+ posts: Top Shipper

sections.heading: Community Support
sections.content:
When you SHIP in #ship, other members will like/react, leave constructive feedback, share if the content is good, and connect if there's synergy.

NLB Culture: "Support first, critique second"

sections.heading: What is a Contributor?
sections.content: A Contributor is an NLB member who helps build the community instead of shipping personal content weekly. This is an alternative path for those who don't want or can't Build in Public but still want to contribute value.

sections.heading: Types of Contributors
sections.content:
• Technical Support: Answer technical questions on Discord, help with debugging, review code, share resources
• Developer: Fix bugs, implement features, update docs, code review — requires assessment by 3 Mentors; commit 4–8 hours/week
• Other: Content, Community, QA/Testing, Design, Research — propose your own contribution format

sections.heading: Application Process
sections.content:
1. Be a paid NLB member
2. Submit Contributor Application Form
3. Mentor review (Developer: thorough assessment, 3–7 days)
4. If approved: Begin 45-day trial period
5. Choose how to contribute + submit weekly reports
6. Mentors conduct overall review
7. Result: CONFIRM, EXTEND, or REMOVE + Refund

sections.heading: 45-Day Trial Period
sections.content:
• Choose tasks/contributions that match your skills
• Submit work report EVERY WEEK (mandatory)
• Still required to submit Feedback Weekly form
• SHIP 4 posts/month requirement is waived during this period

sections.heading: Confirmed Contributor Benefits
sections.content:
• Contributor badge on Discord
• SHIP requirement waived
• +15 RP/week of work
• Early access to NLB products
• Connect with Mentors and Partners
• Reference letter from NLB when needed
• Revenue share from contributed projects (case by case)

sections.heading: Strategic Partner Privileges
sections.content:
For outstanding individuals who are both active Contributors and consistent Shippers:
• Priority to distribute AgentBrain.sh and GoClaw.sh with profit sharing
• Support for packaging your own product based on NLB platforms
• Join strategic meetings with Founders (Co-founder Level Access)

sections.heading: Two Independent Systems
sections.content:
NLB has 2 independent classification systems:
• Membership Type: Based on subscription plan — Premium or VIP
• Member Rank: Based on contributions and activity — Apprentice to Legend

sections.heading: Premium Member
sections.content:
For Builders who want to learn, connect, and SHIP in a professional environment.

Benefits:
• Discord Access: All Premium channels
• Weekly Drops: Full access to weekly content drops in the library
• Resources: Templates, tools, guides
• Community: Network with 30+ builders
• Async Q&A: Priority answers from Mentors in Discord
• Product Access: Access to NLB products

sections.heading: VIP Member
sections.content:
For serious Builders who want to accelerate and have the opportunity to become a Partner.

Benefits = Premium + Priority:
• Early Access: First access to all new products
• Early Bird Slots: Priority pricing on new programs
• Partner Priority: Priority review to become Strategic Partner
• Priority Mentor DM: Direct Discord DM with Mentor (priority queue)
• Direct Access: Chat directly with Mentors
• Co-launch: Opportunity for editorial collaboration on product launches based on community relevance

sections.heading: 5-Tier Ranking System
sections.content:
• Apprentice (Gray): Auto-assigned when joining (0–45 days)
• Builder (Green): >45 days, ≥8 SHIPs, ≥80% feedback, ≥4 weekly check-ins
• Architect (Blue): >90 days, ≥20 SHIPs, ≥90% feedback, helped ≥5 members, ≥2 highlighted posts
• Master (Purple): >6 months, ≥50 SHIPs, ≥95% feedback, Featured/Contributor
• Legend (Gold): >1 year, ≥100 SHIPs, nominated by ≥2 Mentors — max 5% of members

sections.heading: Ranking Points System
sections.content:
• SHIP a post: +10 RP
• SHIP gets highlighted: +25 RP
• Feedback weekly: +5 RP/week
• Active in Discord (week): +3 RP/week
• Help member (verified): +8 RP/time
• Featured contributor: +50 RP/instance
• Contributor work: +15 RP/week
• Product launch: +100 RP

Rank thresholds: Builder 100 RP | Architect 300 RP | Master 800 RP | Legend 2000 RP + Nomination

sections.heading: Upgrade & Downgrade
sections.content:
• Type upgrade (Premium → VIP): Any time, pay the difference, effective immediately
• Ranking: Auto-calculated based on Ranking Points, updated on the 1st of each month
• No downgrade from achieved ranks (only freeze if inactive)
• Legend requires annual re-nomination

sections.heading: Process Overview (7–14 days)
sections.content:
1. Pay membership fee
2. Submit Member Information Form
3. Admin Review & Verify (2–3 days)
4. Submit Commitment Form
5. Receive Discord Access + Onboarding

Note: If you don't pass the review, you will receive a 100% refund.

sections.heading: Review Criteria
sections.content:
Admin evaluates based on:
• Complete information (20%): All required fields filled
• Verified profile (20%): Verifiable links
• Clear goals (25%): Knows what they want to build
• Suitable skills (20%): Has a foundation to build
• Right motivation (15%): Wants to SHIP and learn — not just lurk

sections.heading: Required Commitments
sections.content:
• SHIP at least 4 posts/month as public posts, share in #ship
• Submit Feedback Weekly form EVERY WEEK with substantive content
• Active Discord participation: at least 2 weekly check-ins/month
• Follow NLB's Code of Conduct
• If you don't want to SHIP, apply as a Contributor (requires approval)

sections.heading: Post-Approval Checklist
sections.content:
• Day 1: Read SHIP guidelines, update Discord profile
• Day 2: Introduce yourself in #introductions
• Day 3: Watch the Onboarding Video
• Day 7: Watch Onboarding Video Pt.2 + complete Onboarding Checklist in Discord
• Week 2: SHIP your first post
• Week 2: Submit first Feedback Weekly

sections.heading: Re-application
sections.content:
Requirements: Previously removed due to violations + waited at least 45 days

Process:
1. Submit updated Member Information Form
2. Explain why you want to return
3. Specific commitments about what you'll do differently
4. Admin review (stricter than first time)
5. If approved: Go through the normal process

sections.heading: General Principles
sections.content:
NLB follows a "Fair but Firm" policy — fair to all members, but serious about commitments.

"We don't want to remove anyone. We want everyone to SHIP."

sections.heading: Types of Violations
sections.content:
SHIP violations:
• Minor: 2–3 posts/month
• Moderate: 1 post/month
• Severe: No posts at all
• Critical: No posts for 2 consecutive months

Feedback violations:
• Minor: Miss 1–2 weeks/month
• Severe: No submissions for the whole month or fake submissions (".", "ok", spam)

Code of Conduct violations:
• Spam, off-topic, disrespectful behavior
• Causing conflict, toxic behavior
• Harassment, discrimination

sections.heading: Automated Enforcement Process
sections.content:
The system automatically tracks SHIP count, feedback submissions, and consolidates every 45 days.

At review time:
• Pass: Sufficient SHIP + Feedback + Discord activity → Membership continues
• Fail: Auto-revoke Discord access, revoke credentials, send notification email, process 100% Refund, add to 45-day waiting list

sections.heading: Fast Track (Immediate Action)
sections.content:
Some violations are handled immediately without warning:
• Harassing other members → Immediate termination
• Spam, advertising, scam → Terminate + Permanent ban
• Violating laws → Terminate + Report if needed
• Fake identity → Terminate + Permanent ban
• Leaking internal information → Terminate + Legal review

sections.heading: Refund Policy
sections.content:
100% Refund when:
• Terminated due to commitment violations
• Voluntarily leaving within the first 45 days
• NLB ceases operations

Pro-rata refund: Voluntarily leaving after 45 days (based on remaining time)

No refund: Permanently banned due to serious violations, or membership period has ended

sections.heading: Right to Appeal
sections.content:
If you believe the decision was unfair:
1. Reply to the termination email with your appeal reason
2. Admin reviews within 7 days
3. If unsatisfied, escalate to Co-founders
4. Final decision within 14 days

Required: Specific reason for appeal, evidence (if any), proposed resolution
